notes: v12 lexical: gated fuzzy on letter tokens of length >= 4, edit distance 1, prefix_length 1, name/alias only. Numbers, codes, and house-path keys stay exact. Boost stays below exact/name_compact.

v11 lexical: names_compact is the letter-only fold of the full name/alias. Query emits that key only when a letter token is long enough to be space-glued (vanhanh mall → vanhanhmall). Exact terms, no prefix, no pair index, no name list. Spaced names and house+street queries stay on the existing path.

v10 lexical: index housenumber/street/place from corpus. Leading house+street path uses catalog keys (slash and single-letter glue share a path). Medial numbers stay in BM25. Name-field prefix is off on house+street queries so address-named POIs are not double-counted. No street-type word list.
v9 lexical: a pure number beside a letter span is constant_score number_bonus, not a BM25 term. codes_compact requires both a letter and a digit in one token.
v8 lexical: dotted/hyphenated alphanumeric spans are glued before the standard analyzer (s10.2 and s1.02 share s102). Slash is not glued.
v8 geo: equivalent-name cohort orders by cap*exp(-d/5000m). cap 0.35 < 1 match tier, so an exact far hit stays above a nearer partial.
v8: codes_compact keyword (alnum fold) so S2.02 matches s202 without hard-coded building patterns.
v7 lexical = gold iterate winner v4_photonish (docs/deliveries/w1_evidence/12_LEXICAL_ITERATE.md).
MSM=1; cross/best OR + context_text. Hybrid R@1000 0.999 on gold_stage1_v1.
